scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/web build && JET_BLACK_DEV_SEED=1 cargo run -p jet-black
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && cargo build -p jet-black
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.format: bunx ultracite fix apps/web/src/client apps/web/tests-client packages/shared/src
scripts.check:protocol: bun run generate:protocol && git diff --exit-code -- packages/shared/src/protocol.generated.ts
